dataset = [
    [1200, 2, 10, 45],

code.pseudocode:
A new feature row goes into the trained model.
prediction <- model.predict([1500, 3, 6])
code.python:
# A stand-in formula plays the role of a trained model.
def trained_model(x):
    area, bedrooms, age = x
    return 0.03 * area + 5 * bedrooms - 0.5 * age

new_x = [1500, 3, 6]
print(round(trained_model(new_x), 1))  # 57.0
